copy.headline: What is holding up month-end?
copy.body: Before the cut-off, which lot records does finance still need from operations: unfinished work, completed output or losses?
copy.native_headline: Which factory records are still missing?
copy.alt: Blank factory and finance records approach an open reconciliation point.

copy.headline: Where is unfinished work at cut-off?
copy.body: For each lot, confirm its production stage, the record behind the unfinished quantity and who can verify it.
copy.native_headline: Locate unfinished work by lot
copy.alt: A lot carrier at a neutral process boundary illustrates unfinished work at cut-off.

selected_units.caption: Digiwin manufacturing ERP solutions. Plant managers: review lot records and handoff ownership with finance to address month-end waiting and repeated reconciliation.

copy.headline: Which records explain output and losses?
copy.body: Reconcile completed output, scrap and loss records for the same period before discussing production costs with finance.
copy.native_headline: Reconcile completion and loss records
copy.alt: Separate production and loss records are compared without invented quantities or yield.

selected_units.caption: Digiwin manufacturing ERP solutions. Plant managers: review lot records and handoff ownership with finance to address month-end waiting and repeated reconciliation.

copy.headline: Who confirms the handoff to finance?
copy.body: Agree who checks the factory records, who confirms the figures and when the handoff occurs. Make ownership clear before the cut-off.
copy.native_headline: Clarify ownership before the cut-off
copy.alt: Factory and finance records remain separated by an open confirmation boundary.

copy.headline:
月底將至，
工廠紀錄準備好了嗎？
copy.body:
在製品、完工產量、耗損：
結帳截止前，依批次核對紀錄。
copy.native_headline: 工廠紀錄準備好了嗎？
copy.alt: 示意圖：空白日曆、生產資料夾與封裝晶片托盤，呈現工廠月底核對紀錄的問題。

selected_units.caption: Digiwin提供製造業ERP解決方案。封裝測試工廠的營運主管：哪些批次紀錄，仍讓您與財務的月底討論遲遲無法推進？

copy.headline: 什麼拖慢了月底結帳？
copy.body: 結帳截止前，財務還需要工廠提供哪些批次紀錄：在製品、完工產量，還是耗損？
copy.native_headline: 哪些工廠紀錄尚未齊備？
copy.alt: 工廠與財務的空白紀錄，在待核對的位置相接。

selected_units.caption: Digiwin製造業ERP解決方案。工廠營運主管：與財務核對批次紀錄並釐清交接責任，減少月底等待與重複核對。

copy.headline: 截止時，在製品在哪道製程？
copy.body: 逐批確認製程、未完工數量的紀錄依據，以及負責核實的人。
copy.native_headline: 依批次確認在製品狀態
copy.alt: 中性的製程邊界與批次托盤，示意結帳截止時的在製品。

selected_units.caption: Digiwin製造業ERP解決方案。工廠營運主管：與財務核對批次紀錄並釐清交接責任，減少月底等待與重複核對。

copy.headline: 產量與耗損，有哪些紀錄依據？
copy.body: 先核對同一期間的完工產量、報廢與耗損紀錄，再與財務討論生產成本。
copy.native_headline: 核對完工與耗損紀錄
copy.alt: 分別對照生產與耗損紀錄，不呈現虛構數量或良率。

selected_units.caption: Digiwin製造業ERP解決方案。工廠營運主管：與財務核對批次紀錄並釐清交接責任，減少月底等待與重複核對。

copy.headline: 交給財務前，誰負責確認？
copy.body: 釐清誰核查工廠紀錄、誰確認資料、何時交接。結帳截止前，先把責任說清楚。
copy.native_headline: 結帳截止前，釐清交接責任
copy.alt: 工廠與財務紀錄，由待確認的交接邊界連接。

selected_units.caption: Digiwin製造業ERP解決方案。工廠營運主管：與財務核對批次紀錄並釐清交接責任，減少月底等待與重複核對。

copy.headline: 讓工廠紀錄成為成本討論的依據
copy.body: 採用已核對的當期在製品與耗損紀錄，讓工廠與財務有共同的討論依據。
